items.name: problem decomposition artifact
items.fix: Create references/problem_decomposition.md with targets, variables, outputs, constraints, candidates, validation, visuals, and risks for every subquestion.

items.name: raw attachment/data files
items.fix: Put official problem statement and attachments in data/raw, or mark missing official files as blockers.

items.name: source/provenance record
items.fix: Record data/problem/source provenance in references/sources.md.

items.name: variable availability audit
items.fix: Create references/variable_audit.md or reports/variable_audit.json with availability classes, leakage risks, and split design.

items.name: model selection record
items.fix: Create references/model_selection.md with task type, baseline, candidates, selected model, rejection reasons, and validation.

items.name: data dictionary
items.fix: Create references/data_dictionary.md with field meanings, units, types, missing/outlier handling, and sources.

items.name: body has no process traces
items.fix: Remove tool names, code paths, workflow/benchmark/gap/scorer language, and generation-process wording from the paper body and abstract.

items.name: required body sections
items.fix: Add missing formal contest-paper sections.

items.name: no Q&A or review filler
items.fix: Remove Q&A appendices, manual-review prose, user/scorer/revision meta text, file-path instructions, and filler.

items.name: formulas, objectives, constraints
items.fix: Add numbered formulas, objective/loss functions, constraints, and model equations in the body.

items.name: subquestion coverage
items.fix: Make every subquestion explicit and provide a model, result, validation, and conclusion.

items.name: baseline/model comparison
items.fix: Compare simple baselines with selected models, or justify why no baseline is meaningful.

items.name: assumptions symbols algorithm
items.fix: Add problem-specific assumptions, a symbol table with units, and algorithm steps.

items.name: task-specific model checks
items.fix: Satisfy task-specific checks for prediction, classification, optimization, evaluation, grouping, time-series, simulation, mechanism, graph, or queueing tasks.

items.name: leakage audit passes
items.fix: Classify variable availability and remove or restrict post-decision/target-proxy variables.

items.name: validation metrics
items.fix: Add task-appropriate validation metrics with numbers.

items.name: sensitivity analysis
items.fix: Add numerical sensitivity analysis for important parameters, weights, data perturbations, or grouping boundaries.

items.name: robustness or uncertainty
items.fix: Add robustness, uncertainty, confidence interval, bootstrap, Monte Carlo, or extreme-scenario evidence.

items.name: split design matches data structure
items.fix: Use grouped, temporal, or spatial validation when data contain repeated entities, time, regions, devices, teams, or routes.

items.name: single run entry
items.fix: Create src/run_all.py or an equivalent documented single entry point.

items.name: summary metrics json
items.fix: Write reports/summary.json with key model metrics and final results.

items.name: processed outputs
items.fix: Generate processed data, tables, figures, or metrics from scripts.

items.name: support materials package
items.fix: Create support README, data-processing instructions, model-running instructions, quality report, and self-check report.

items.name: AI-use record if used
items.fix: Create support/ai_usage.md if AI or LLM assistance was used.

items.name: appendix reproduction only
items.fix: Keep reproduction commands in appendix/support materials, not the body.

items.name: figure count
items.fix: Generate at least 8 decision-relevant figures for a full multi-question project.

items.name: figure resolution/vector quality
items.fix: Regenerate low-resolution figures at >=1000x600 px or as vector PDF/SVG.

items.name: table count
items.fix: Generate at least 6 result, validation, or robustness tables.

items.name: figure diversity
items.fix: Include diverse figure roles: data profile, diagnostic, decision/evaluation/grouping/network, and sensitivity/robustness as relevant.

items.name: Chinese figure labels/captions
items.fix: Use Chinese titles, captions, axes, legends, and units; provide a figure manifest when possible.

items.name: captions and text references
items.fix: Caption and discuss figures/tables near their interpretation.

items.name: paper source depth
items.fix: Expand the main body to at least 14000 CJK/word characters and total paper to 18000+ with real modeling detail.

items.name: abstract density
items.fix: Write a 450-900 Chinese-character abstract with methods, key numerical results, and validation for each subquestion.

items.name: compiled PDF and page range
items.fix: Compile a PDF with 18-28 pages, with body dense and appendix supportive.

items.name: LaTeX log clean enough
items.fix: Fix LaTeX compile errors, overfull boxes, undefined references/citations, and layout warnings.

items.name: reference quality
items.fix: Use references for current domain, methods, data/statistical standards, and software/algorithms; do not rely only on templates or public excellent papers.

items.name: result scope and sanity
items.fix: State applicability, limitations, boundary/extreme checks, and common-sense sanity checks.

items.name: numeric precision
items.fix: Avoid fake precision with excessive decimal places in recommendations, scores, or boundaries.

items.name: no TODO placeholders
items.fix: Remove TODO/placeholders from paper and core references/support artifacts before final delivery.
